name: PDF Catalog for WooCommerce + Drag And Drop Template Builder
author: add-ons.org

sections.description:
DEMO: https://demo.add-ons.org/woocommerce-pdf-catalog/product/beanie/
DOCUMENT: https://pdf.add-ons.org/document-pdf-catalog-for-woocommerce/
Pro Version: https://add-ons.org/plugin/pdf-catalog-for-woocommerce/

Let your customers generate professional product catalogs directly from the frontend – no coding needed!

PDF Catalog Builder for WooCommerce is a powerful plugin that allows users to generate fully customized PDF product catalogs right from the frontend of your website. Whether you’re a store owner, wholesaler, or B2B supplier, this tool makes it easy for your customers or team to create print-ready, branded catalogs with just a few clicks.

Thanks to the built-in Drag & Drop Template Builder, you can design your own catalog layout exactly the way you want — choose what product data to show, how it should be displayed, and in what format.

Features

  • Visual Drag & Drop Template Builder: No coding required! Simply drag elements like product name, price, image, SKU, barcode, and more into your preferred layout. Customize headers, footers, spacing, and fonts easily.
  • Works on the Frontendr: The plugin integrates directly with your site’s frontend, allowing visitors or customers to generate PDF catalogs without needing access to the admin area. Ideal for stores offering wholesale or quote-based pricing.
  • Flexible Product Selection: Users can generate catalogs based on product categories, tags, or manually selected products — perfect for custom brochures or sales presentations.
  • Download or Email the PDF Instantly: Customers can download the PDF immediately or have it sent directly to their email inbox. Great for lead generation, follow-ups, and internal use.
  • Fully Customizable Design: Adjust typography, colors, layouts, spacing, and more. Include logos, custom headers, and promotional banners to match your brand identity.
  • Always Up-To-Date Product Data: The catalog pulls real-time product information from your WooCommerce store — including pricing, inventory, and images — ensuring accuracy and consistency.
  • Multilingual and RTL Support: Compatible with WPML, Polylang, and supports Right-to-Left (RTL) languages for global audiences.
  • Optimized for Speed and Developer-Friendly: Lightweight and built for performance. Developers can also hook into the plugin for deeper integration or automation.
  • Multiple Catalog Templates: Create and reuse different templates for seasonal catalogs, price sheets, wholesale offers, etc.
  • Live Product Data from WooCommerce: PDFs pull real-time data (price, stock, images, etc.) from your store.

WooCommerce PDF Catalog

sections.installation:
Normal installation

  1. Download the woocommerce.zip file to your computer.
  2. Unzip the file.
  3. Upload the plugin.zip directory to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  4. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
